```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_rows(genre, sep = ",\\s*")
```

```{r}
ggplot(movies, aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram(na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Tomatometer Scores",
    subtitle = paste("Number of films:", sum(!is.na(movies$tomatoMeter))),
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count"
  )
```

```{r}
movies_gap <- movies_clean |>
  filter(
    is.na(tomatoMeter) | tomatoMeter != 0,
    is.na(audienceScore) | audienceScore != 0
  ) |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore)

movies_summary <- movies_gap |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarise(mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE), n = n()) |>
  filter(n >= 100) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)

movies_summary
```

```{r}
ggplot(movies_summary, aes(x = mean_gap, y = fct_reorder(genre, desc(mean_gap)))) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Average Score Gap by Genre",
    subtitle = "Negative gaps favor audiences; positive gaps favor critics.",
    x = "Mean Tomatometer minus audience score",
    y = "Genre"
  )
```

```{r}
spiderman <- movies |>
  filter(title %in% c(
    "Spider-Man",
    "Spider-Man 2",
    "Spider-Man 3",
    "The Amazing Spider-Man",
    "The Amazing Spider-Man 2",
    "Spider-Man: Homecoming",
    "Spider-Man: Far From Home",
    "Spider-Man: No Way Home"
  )) |>
  mutate(actor = case_when(
    str_detect(title, "Amazing") ~ "Andrew Garfield",
    str_detect(title, ":") ~ "Tom Holland",
    TRUE ~ "Tobey Maguire"
  )) |>
  arrange(releaseDateTheaters)

spiderman |>
  mutate(title = fct_reorder(title, releaseDateTheaters)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(tomatoMeter, audienceScore),
    names_to = "source",
    values_to = "score"
  ) |>
  mutate(source = recode(
    source,
    tomatoMeter = "Tomatometer",
    audienceScore = "Audience"
  )) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = title, y = score, color = source, group = source)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)) +
  labs(
    title = "Critics rated the original Spider-Man trilogy higher than audiences",
    x = "Film (release order)",
    y = "Score",
    color = "Score source"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
